task: Finish concurrent-loop support (the proxy core is DONE and committed: lock_owners set + owner payload handling + lock_owners in GET /mode). Remaining work, in four small pieces: (1) llmc/cli.py: `llmc lock` and `llmc unlock` gain an `--owner` flag that is passed through as "owner" in the /mode payload (ProxyClient.set_lock signature gains owner=None and includes it in the body only when set); `llmc status` prints the owners (e.g. 'Locked: loop (owners: a, b)' - read lock_owners from the /mode payload, fall back gracefully when absent). (2) llmc/tests/test_proxy.py: ADD unit tests for the owner semantics over HTTP, mirroring the existing TestModelLock helpers - cover: second owner shares the lock, owner release keeps the lock until the last owner, ownerless clear force-clears, lock_owners appears in GET /mode. ADD ONLY; do not modify existing tests. (3) proxy.py polish: the lock-CLEAR response currently returns {"locked": None} even when other owners still hold the lock - make it echo the actual current state ({"locked": self.ctx.lock_model} after the mutation). One line. (4) models/loop.toml: parallel_slots = 2 (context_size stays 196608 - llama.cpp splits total ctx across slots, so 2x98K; update the comment that currently says '1 slot'). (5) Docs: AGENTS.md model-lock section and README.md - add a short 'Concurrent loops' note: loops can share one preset concurrently (lock with a distinct --owner per session, e.g. the pi session id); when looping the same repo use a separate git worktree per loop; loop sensors must never rebuild/restart the stack that serves them.
